info.title: Omni Z-API - Webhooks API
info.description: API to create and manage webhook endpoints per channel. Any valid secret key of an active workspace can use these routes. It also includes the delivery center: history, resend and health of the workspace webhooks.

post.description: Registers a new webhook endpoint on the channel. From creation, configured events are delivered to the provided URL.

get.description: Lists the deliveries of the webhooks in the secret key's workspace, newest first. Without `from`, it starts 24 hours before the call. A `from` earlier than the period the plan keeps is adjusted, with `fromAdjusted: true`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filters by one status. Accepts upper or lower case. A delivery with a resend in progress only shows up in `RESENT`

parameters.name: eventType
parameters.description: Filters by one event type, such as `MESSAGE_RECEIVED` or `UPDATE_TEMPLATE_STATUS`. Accepts upper or lower case

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Filters by one event, by the UUID in `x-webhook-event-id`

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the period, in ISO-8601. Default: 24 hours before the call. Must be earlier than `to`

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the period, in ISO-8601. Default: the time of the call

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous page. Opaque value

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: Filters by one destination address, with sensitive parts hidden, without query, with scheme and host in lower case. 1 to 2048 characters, not starting with `#`. Cannot be combined with `destinationUnavailable`

parameters.name: destinationUnavailable
parameters.description: Only accepts `true`: deliveries with no readable destination address. Cannot be combined with `destination`

url.description: Destination URL for the events: absolute, `http` or `https`, up to 2048 characters. The host must exist in DNS and resolve only to public addresses; otherwise, `400`.

events.description: Event types to receive. At least one required. Names are accepted in any letter case; a name that does not exist, null or blank returns `400`.

signing.description: Enables HMAC-SHA256 signing. When `true`, a 64-character hex `secret` is generated and returned **only on create/update**. Use it to verify the authenticity of incoming requests.

payloadFormat.description: Format of the payload delivered to the webhook. `DEFAULT` is the Omni Z-API format; `Z_API` keeps the Z-API structure for those migrating; `CHATWOOT` delivers in the format Chatwoot expects.

UpdateWebhookRequest.description: All fields are optional — only the fields sent are updated.

url.description: New destination URL, under the same rules as on creation. It is only checked when it changes.

events.description: New event list. Replaces the events the API knows; a stored event the API does not know yet is kept. Cannot be empty (`400`).

status.description: `DISABLED` pauses event delivery without deleting the webhook Any other value returns `400`.

signing.description: Enables or rotates the HMAC signature. Generates a new `secret` returned in the response.

WebhookAuth.description: Configures how Omni Z-API authenticates when calling your URL

token.description: Token for `BEARER` authentication — sent in the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header

key.description: Key for `API_KEY` authentication, sent in the `X-API-Key` header

WebhookAuthInfo.description: Summary of configured authentication — credentials are not returned for security

channelId.description: ID of the channel this webhook belongs to

events.description: Configured event types A stored event the API does not know yet is not listed here.

signing.description: Indicates whether HMAC signing is enabled

secret.description: 64-character hex HMAC secret — returned **only** when `signing` is enabled on create or update. Store it securely; it cannot be retrieved later.

error.description: Delivery center error. On `400`, `422` and `429`, an object with `message` and, when present, `type` and `details`. On `404`, a generic text. On `503`, the message text. On `502`, `integration_unavailable`

deliveryId.description: Delivery ID, the same as the `x-webhook-delivery-id` header

eventId.description: Event ID, the same as the `x-webhook-event-id` header

channelId.description: Channel ID. `null` for events that do not belong to a channel

lastHttpStatus.description: HTTP status of the last attempt. `null` when there was no response

lastOutcome.description: Outcome of the last attempt, such as `SUCCEEDED`, `HTTP_ERROR`, `TIMEOUT` or `CONNECTION_ERROR`

nextAttemptAt.description: Time of the next attempt, when one is scheduled

resendable.description: Whether the delivery can be resent now

notResendableReason.description: Why the delivery cannot be resent. `null` when it can, or when the webhook was deleted

notSentReason.description: Why nothing was sent on the last attempt. Only in `NOT_SENT`

resentAt.description: When the resend in progress was requested. Only in `RESENT`

source.description: `APP` on deliveries to a connected app. Absent on the others

appName.description: Connected app name. Only when `source` is `APP`

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page. `null` when there are no more pages

fromAdjusted.description: `true` when `from` was earlier than the kept period and was moved to its start

attemptNumber.description: Attempt number, the same as the `x-webhook-attempt` header

resentBy.description: Who requested the resend. Only in `MANUAL_RESEND`

errorMessage.description: Error message, with sensitive parts hidden

url.description: URL called, with sensitive parts hidden

requestHeaders.description: Headers sent, with sensitive parts hidden

requestBodyTruncated.description: `true` when the body sent was cut

responseBody.description: Body of your endpoint's response. `null` when `bodyHidden` is `true`

responseBodyTruncated.description: `true` when the response body was cut

deliveryId.description: Delivery ID, the same as the `x-webhook-delivery-id` header

eventId.description: Event ID, the same as the `x-webhook-event-id` header

channelId.description: Channel ID. `null` for events that do not belong to a channel

lastHttpStatus.description: HTTP status of the last attempt. `null` when there was no response

lastOutcome.description: Outcome of the last attempt, such as `SUCCEEDED`, `HTTP_ERROR`, `TIMEOUT` or `CONNECTION_ERROR`

nextAttemptAt.description: Time of the next attempt, when one is scheduled

resendable.description: Whether the delivery can be resent now

notResendableReason.description: Why the delivery cannot be resent. `null` when it can, or when the webhook was deleted

notSentReason.description: Why nothing was sent on the last attempt. Only in `NOT_SENT`

resentAt.description: When the resend in progress was requested. Only in `RESENT`

bodyHidden.description: `true` when the bodies are not in the response

source.description: `APP` on deliveries to a connected app. Absent on the others

appName.description: Connected app name. Only when `source` is `APP`

deliveryId.description: Delivery ID, the same as the `x-webhook-delivery-id` header

attemptNumber.description: Number of the new attempt. Arrives in the `x-webhook-attempt` header

message.description: Only when there was no confirmation in time that the resend went out. Check the result in the delivery detail

episode.description: Only accepts `current`: the current failure sequence

remaining.description: Deliveries still left. Request another batch after 2 minutes

skippedTruncated.description: Deliveries with a body over the stored limit, which cannot be resent

skippedNotResendable.description: Deliveries with an unreadable body, or with another resend started at the same time

dailyRemaining.description: Resends that still fit today on this webhook (UTC day)

oldestExpiresAt.description: When the oldest delivery left leaves the history. `null` when none is left

channelId.description: Channel ID. `null` for the default and template webhooks

state.description: Webhook state. `SUSPENDED`: webhook suspended. `NO_HISTORY`: `CHATWOOT` format, no history

consecutiveFailures.description: Consecutive failures since the last success. `null` in `NO_HISTORY`

failingSince.description: Start of the failure sequence, when an email notice was sent or is pending

alertsGiven.description: Email notices sent in the current failure sequence. `null` in `NO_HISTORY`

alertPending.description: `true` when an email notice is about to be sent

episodeStartedAt.description: Start of the current failure sequence

retainedSince.description: After a reactivation, the start of the failure sequence it ended

retentionDays.description: Days the history keeps deliveries, according to the plan

webhooks.description: State of each webhook in the workspace

bearerAuth.description: Secret Key generated in the Omni Z-API Security panel
